description: Search Anopheles mosquito vector-occurrence records: collection site, survey period, species identification, and sampling method, optionally filtered by country and/or a species-name substring (e.g. "gambiae"). Data: Malaria Atlas Project GeoServer WFS (data.malariaatlas.org), no auth required.

country.description: ISO3166 alpha-3 country code to filter mosquito vector records (e.g. "SDN").

limit.description: Maximum number of vector occurrence records to return (1-200). Defaults to 50.

species.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the Anopheles species name (e.g. "gambiae", "arabiensis").

name: malaria-atlas.entomology.vector_occurrence

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Anopheles Vector Occurrence
